rights_basis: The Pustet Ratisbon 1862 historical printing is public domain in the United States by publication date. This bounded image-checked transcription adds no prayer words and is excluded from the project CC BY 4.0 grant.
text: Deus, qui per sanctum Josephum Confessorem tuum, ad erudiendam spiritu intelligentiae, ac pietatis juventutem novum Ecclesiae tuae subsidium providere dignatus es: praesta, quaesumus, nos ejus exemplo, et intercessione ita facere, et docere, ut praemia consequamur aeterna. Per Dominum.
